## Activity

During August 2022, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 33 captures. Activity was maintained across the reporting period, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The reported volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 33 captures, 2 were ungradable. This produced an ungradable rate of 6.1. The result is recorded for monitoring purposes and should be considered alongside the grading outcomes for the month.

## Grading

A total of 2 results were graded referable during August 2022. The median grading lag was 13 days. This records the midpoint time between capture and the completion of grading and provides an overall indication of service timeliness for the reporting period.
